root_causes.detail: Module control state persists, but production module execution routes do not read module_control_states, so disabled modules are not proven to be blocked.
Focused backend integration tests require BARONG_TEST_DB_READY=1 after Alembic upgrade on an isolated test database. This environment was not prepared, so backend tests did not pass.
Production module center read took 22-29s. Workspace frontend timeout was raised, but backend route should still be optimized before final seal.
